findings.title: Four recommendations emit claims without structured provenance
findings.where: The returned recommendation objects at retry-prefix-rewaste.ts:79-98, retry-storms.ts:15-27, self-update-health.ts:49-75, and tool-errors.ts:47-84 omit `provenance`.
findings.what: Counts, rates, token quantities, savings, and behavioral inferences are presented through detail/evidence fields without structured observations naming the source artifact and exact fields. The claims therefore do not satisfy the release gate's evidence-backed, reproducible recommendation contract.
findings.fix: Add a `provenance` object to each recommendation with observations citing the relevant parser and fields, finite values reproducing displayed counts/rates, and a separate inference for causal or remediation conclusions.
findings.acceptance: For a firing fixture from each detector, provenance validation passes; every displayed numeric claim can be reproduced from cited fields, and tests fail if provenance is removed.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read each complete return object at baseline c8b98a29508b: all four include detail/evidence but none contains a provenance property. Comparison-only support: the baseline provenance validator defines non-empty observations and source citations, while other audited detectors already emit them.

findings.title: Self-update history is presented as current health without an as-of date
findings.what: The card reports captured update success, failures, retry cadence, and version drift and recommends pinning based on those historical snapshots, but it neither exposes the newest snapshot date nor marks the claim `as of <date>`. Old retained records can therefore read as current CLI health.
findings.fix: Derive the newest valid update timestamp, attach it as `provenance.asOf`, set stale status using the shared freshness policy, and make stale card wording explicitly say `as of <date>` while demoting urgency.
findings.acceptance: A fixture whose newest update result is older than the freshness threshold renders an `as of YYYY-MM-DD` qualification with demoted posture; a fresh fixture retains normal posture and cites the newest timestamp field.
findings.verifyNote: Second pass confirmed the entire emitted detail/action at baseline lines 54-66 contains no timestamp or as-of qualifier. The related baseline analyzer sorts timestamped records and derives historical cadence/version drift, so a newest observation date is available but discarded by this detector.
